name: LeadPulse Draft-Review Language Safeguard
scope: A contact-level language awareness layer for the Ebimaru drafting brief. P1 draft-review safeguard.

design_intent.pattern: Draft-review language badge with automatic override
design_intent.not: A global app-language setting or a send-time language auto-detector
design_intent.goal: Make the client's demonstrated language visible at the moment Pat reviews a draft, so the outbound message matches the client's own words — and auto-detect when that language is unclear.
design_intent.core_rule: Language is a contact-level fact. Pat's choice is already made when they pick the draft card — no separate override step.

validated_findings: Scheduled work comes first; high-priority unscheduled deals need a forced date-or-park queue.
No linked contact means contact research, not outreach. Generic routes are fallback, not equal to named buyers.
Reply must mean a usable inbound response exists. Otherwise it belongs in Waiting/Follow-up with a date.
language_specific: Clients in VG Saveur's market write in Thai, English, or a mix. Assuming one or the other risks a tone-deaf first message.
The client's last inbound message is the strongest evidence of their preferred language.
When the language is genuinely unclear, the system auto-detects and Pat can tell Ebimaru which language to pick on a case-by-case basis.

contact_fields.name: outreach_language
contact_fields.purpose: The client's demonstrated preferred language for outbound messages.

contact_fields.name: outreach_language_basis
contact_fields.purpose: Why the system believes this is the client's language.

rules: outreach_language defaults to 'autodetect' for all existing contacts. No backfill from name or company heuristics.
outreach_language_basis defaults to 'autodetect'. Only an explicit inbound interaction or a Pat override changes it.
A new inbound interaction in Thai updates outreach_language to 'thai' and basis to 'last_inbound' — only if the current basis is not 'pat_override'.
A new inbound interaction in English updates outreach_language to 'english' and basis to 'last_inbound' — only if the current basis is not 'pat_override'.
Mixed or ambiguous inbound leaves outreach_language unchanged at 'autodetect' unless Pat explicitly overrides.

Pat's choice is already made when they pick the draft card. Selecting a Thai draft sets outreach_language = 'thai', basis = 'pat_override'. Selecting an English draft sets outreach_language = 'english', basis = 'pat_override'.

draft_card_design.name: Draft review card with language badge
draft_card_design.entry_point: Ebimaru drafting brief section in DealDetail, shown when workflow_action is outreach, reply, or reschedule.
structure: Language badge — prominent, top-left of the draft card.
Original inbound context — collapsed snippet of the client's last message, visible with one tap.
Draft preview — the proposed outbound text.
Draft language selector: 'Draft in Thai' / 'Draft in English' — Pat's choice here IS the language setting.
Send / edit / cancel actions — unchanged from current flow.

language_badge_states.note: No selector needed — language is known.
No selector needed — language is known.
Draft language selector shown: Draft in Thai / Draft in English. Pat's choice writes the contact record automatically.

override_behavior: Pat's choice is already made when they pick the draft card — no separate override step.
Clicking 'Draft in Thai' regenerates the draft in Thai AND writes outreach_language = 'thai', basis = 'pat_override' to the contact record.
Clicking 'Draft in English' regenerates the draft in English AND writes outreach_language = 'english', basis = 'pat_override' to the contact record.
The write is automatic and auditable — every draft-language choice is a Pat choice recorded on the contact.
A Pat-overridden language is not silently overwritten by a later inbound interaction.

behavior: The system does not auto-translate by default.
When Pat picks a draft card, they tell Ebimaru which language to pick — Thai or English.
Ebimaru regenerates the draft in the chosen language with the original inbound as context.
This is an explicit per-draft instruction, not a system-wide auto-translation feature.

inbound_context_display.purpose: Let Pat verify the language claim against the client's own words.
behavior: Show the most recent inbound interaction's first 2-3 lines, collapsed.
Tap to expand and read the full inbound thread.
If no inbound interaction exists, show 'No inbound message on record — auto-detect.'

what_this_does_not_do.no_auto_send: The draft card never sends a message. Pat always reviews and explicitly sends.
what_this_does_not_do.no_global_setting: There is no app-wide 'default to Thai' toggle. Language is per-contact, per-evidence.
what_this_does_not_do.no_silent_default: When language is autodetect, the system does not pick Thai or English on its own. It shows the selector.
what_this_does_not_do.no_deal_level_field: Language lives on the contact, not the deal. A deal inherits it through the linked contact.
what_this_does_not_do.no_blind_auto_translate: Auto-translation is case-by-case. Pat tells Ebimaru which language to pick per draft.

visual_language.badge_style: Pill badge, 12px, monospace eyebrow, positioned top-left of the draft card.
visual_language.selector_row: Two equal-weight buttons, outlined, below the draft preview. Only visible when outreach_language = 'autodetect'.
visual_language.inbound_context: Collapsed accordion, 11px text, clay-surface background, top border.

preserve: Existing drafting brief section and its workflow-action gating.
Existing explicit Save, spinner, toast, success ring, and undo patterns.
Existing contact identity-quality model — language is additive, not a replacement.
Existing interaction ledger as the source of truth for inbound language evidence.
avoid: Adding language to the deal record — it belongs on the contact.
Auto-detecting language from message text without an explicit inbound interaction.
Overriding a Pat-set language without a new explicit Pat choice.
Showing the selector row when language is already known (thai/english with basis = last_inbound).

acceptance_criteria: A contact with no inbound interaction shows 'Auto-detect' and shows the draft language selector.
A contact with a Thai inbound shows 'Thai' and hides the selector.
A contact with an English inbound shows 'English' and hides the selector.
A contact with mixed/ambiguous inbound shows 'Auto-detect' and shows the selector.
Pat clicking 'Draft in Thai' writes outreach_language = 'thai' and basis = 'pat_override' to the contact record.
Pat clicking 'Draft in English' writes outreach_language = 'english' and basis = 'pat_override' to the contact record.
A Pat-overridden language is not silently overwritten by a later inbound interaction.
The original inbound context is visible with one tap from the draft card.
No message is ever sent without Pat's explicit review and send action.
Auto-translation is case-by-case — Pat tells Ebimaru which language to pick per draft.
depends_on: P0 Reply-lane data hygiene (modal already live, cleaning in progress).
